value.rationale: n=5 is the sharp first natural order where triangle-free differs from bipartite by twelve labeled 5-cycle faces. The resulting first cutoff changes the established bipartite homotopy from a pure third-dimensional wedge (rank 16 by Euler) to a mixed wedge of rank-five H3 and rank-one H4, and determines the entire S5 representation and invariant classes.
